SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-07-2023 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST BY DEFENDANT FOR PAYMENT TO FEB-22-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. COURT GRANTS CONTINUANCE AND ORDERS THE DEFENDANT HAVE UNTIL FRIDAY 2-10-23 FOR PAYMENT. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ERIC GROVER; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
